definition: OpenAI Operator was an AI agent developed by OpenAI, capable of autonomously performing tasks through web browser interactions, including filling forms, placing online orders, scheduling appointments, and other repetitive browser-based tasks.
details: It uses OpenAI's advanced models to expand practical automation capabilities for users in daily activities. Operator was launched on January 23, 2025. It was released as a limited-access research preview to ChatGPT Pro-tier subscribers in the United States on February 1, 2025, with future plans to broaden availability. Operator was deprecated after the release of ChatGPT agent, and shut down on August 31, 2025. ChatGPT agent, which had absorbed Operator's browser-control functionality, was itself removed from ChatGPT in early August 2026 without an advance deprecation notice; OpenAI's help center directed remaining users to ChatGPT Work and to a separate cloud browser feature for browser-based workflows.

explainer.lead: OpenAI Operator was an AI agent that autonomously performed browser tasks such as filling forms, placing orders and scheduling appointments. It mattered as a step toward practical everyday automation, and it also illustrates how quickly agent products get replaced.

tiers.eli5: It is like a helper that clicks around websites for you: filling in forms, buying things and booking times.
tiers.practitioner: Launched January 23, 2025 and released February 1, 2025 as a limited research preview to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the United States. The pitfall is depending on a preview product: it was deprecated after ChatGPT agent absorbed its browser-control functionality and shut down August 31, 2025.
tiers.paperLevel: An agent that drives a web browser autonomously using OpenAI models to complete repetitive browser-based tasks. Its scope was limited by preview access and later by product retirement.

explainer.example: A Pro subscriber in the United States could have Operator fill out a form and place an online order on their behalf during the 2025 preview.
